title: Harpreet Sandhu
intro:
Report an officeholder change
Harpreet Sandhu is a member of the AC Transit District Board of Directors in California, representing Ward 1. Sandhu assumed office on October 29, 2025.
Sandhu won re-election to the AC Transit District Board of Directors to represent Ward 1 in California outright without appearing on the ballot. If the election had not been canceled, the general election would have been held on November 3, 2026.
The Alameda-Contra Costa Transit District (AC Transit) Board of Directors appointed Sandhu to the AC Transit District Board of Directors Ward 1 on October 29, 2025, to replace H. E. Christian Peeples (Nonpartisan).
